title: Online ESL Teacher
description:

title: Air Travel Concierge
description:
At Cranky Concierge, we strive to be the most useful and worry-free travel service available for all travelers. We use our superior industry knowledge to book travel, monitor for issues, and intervene when things go wrong. 

We specialize in providing air travel assistance to people at various points in their travels.  The Concierge's primary responsibility is to help people if something goes wrong during the hours that the flight planning office is closed, but will also overlap with office hours at the beginning or end of the day.  

Shift Timings

We’re looking for someone to cover the following shifts on a regular basis and are prioritizing applicants based in Australia:

  • Mondays – 7pm to 3am New York Time (Tuesdays 9am to 5pm AEST)

  • Tuesdays – 7pm to 3am New York Time (Wednesdays 9am to 5pm AEST)

  • Saturdays –  8pm to 3am New York Time (Sundays 10am to 5pm (AEST)

While the shifts listed above would be your regular shifts, there would be opportunities to pick up additional shifts in line with operational needs and to provide cover for other team members. 

For this role, we want someone passionate about helping stranded travelers get where they need to go. You have to like dealing with people and understanding what they need, even if they aren't entirely sure.

Salary range: US$15-$17.50/hour

Job Responsibilities

  • Concierges are on duty to answer any urgent questions and help travelers who are stuck overnight.  Email and phone systems are programmed to alert if there's a problem, but other notifications may come in.

  • Some urgent questions may require a simple response or update (such as a slight delay with no impact on plans). Others may involve finding new flight options for cancellations and missed connections. This will often be done in the Sabre GDS.

  • Available to answer urgent phone calls and provide help if needed (sometimes, those calls to the urgent line aren't all that urgent!).

  • Prepare and send flight updates.

  • Assist with tasks such as processing refunds, filing for compensation, and other pre- and post-travel tasks as needed.  

  • When needed and workload permits, the concierge will assist with travel planning, including but not limited to searching for and booking air travel, hotels, car rentals, and transfers.  This will mainly be done by email but may also entail phone calls.

If this sounds like the kind of thing you like to do, then keep reading!

Skills You Should Possess (and Other Stuff)

  • Reliability is critical. Must be available and able to assist within 10 minutes of any alert notification.

  • Must have good knowledge of airline networks and options to be able to find alternates quickly for stranded clients.

  • Knowledge of Sabre or other GDS/ARS is preferred but not required.

  • Accuracy and speed are essential. Timing is everything when it comes to this role.

  • Common sense ability to help clients better understand what they need or should want is required.

  • Able to work with little supervision.  There are times you’ll be the only person on.  You won’t ever be completely on an island, as there will always be someone you can reach out to, which leads us to…

  • Never be too proud. If you don't know the answer, then be willing to ask others for help.

  • Must be able to roll with the punches and maintain a calm demeanor. The client may be stressed and angry; you can't be.

  • Background checks will be required - the job involves handling sensitive client data.

All work is done remotely so make sure that you have a comfortable place to work. Work will be done on your computer (Windows or IOS), and you must have reliable internet and a smartphone (Android or iPhone). Communication with clients and airlines is a mix of email and phone, so you must have a quiet work environment.

We can't stress enough how important attention to detail is, so please be sure to include your favorite airline in your application.

title: Head of Insurance Operations
description:
SafetyWing is seeking a Head of Insurance Operations to build and lead our global insurance operations. You’ll own everything from underwriting coordination to claims oversight - making sure our systems are smooth, scalable, and ready to grow with us. This role is about creating efficient processes, solving operational challenges, and ensuring that all our members have a joyful experience.
 

We are on a mission to remove the role of geographical borders as a barrier to equal opportunities and freedom for everyone. And we are doing that by creating simple health, insurance, and retirement products for remote workers worldwide as a replacement for national welfare systems.

👩‍💻 Your responsibilities will include

  • Overseeing the full insurance operations lifecycle - from underwriting coordination to claims resolution - ensuring speed, accuracy, and fairness at every step
  • Building and leading a strong insurance operations team that delivers excellent service
  • Monitoring claims handling to ensure members receive fair outcomes, clear communication, and a consistently positive experience
  • Managing relationships with partners to ensure smooth collaboration
  • Creating and maintaining clear step-by-step procedures, process maps, and documentation so the team can work consistently and scale easily
  • Leading the creation and implementation of business continuity and resilience plans
  • Ensuring all operations meet global compliance requirements and industry standards (in close partnership with the compliance team)
  • Partnering with product, engineering, and finance teams to introduce tools that automate and improve workflows
  • Using data to track performance, solve problems, and guide continuous improvements

🧪 We are looking for someone who

  • Has 5+ years of experience in insurance operations or healthcare, with a proven track record of building scalable systems
  • Understands insurance products, compliance requirements, and operational best practices
  • Loves solving problems with creative, scalable solutions
  • Is analytical and metrics-oriented, able to analyze data, identify issues, and develop effective solutions
  • Understands the broader business context and can make informed, strategic decisions
  • Has strong leadership skills and experience growing high-performing teams
     

😀 We like to work with people who

  • Want to help build a global social safety net on the Internet
  • Think for themselves instead of copying others
  • Are willing to try new things, even with the risk of failure
  • Are intellectually curious and open to new ideas
  • Are creative and bold in the face of any problems
  • Have strong integrity and do the right thing

🧘 What we offer

  • Fully remote work environment -  work from anywhere globally
  • Competitive salary and equity compensation
  • Premium health insurance that travels with you
  • Personal development budget
  • Laptop and office stipends
  • A minimum of four weeks of vacation per year
  • Travel insurance any time you travel
  • Multiple team gatherings per year in amazing locations - our previous meetups were in Mexico, Bali, Siglufjörður and Hoi An
     

🚀 We look forward to hear from you!

title: AI Empowered Chief of Staff & Executive Administrator
description:
About WN Capital Partners

WN Capital Partners is a micro family office that operates like a high-growth startup. We're AI-first, globally distributed, and built for scale. Unlike traditional corporations, we function as a lean operation managing three core business verticals:

  • Real Estate Group (Private Investments): Maryland-based residential and commercial properties, syndication, venture capital, investments.

  • WNCP AI (Consulting): AI consulting through WNCP.AI plus digital brands

We use AI and automation to maintain a 10x efficiency advantage over traditional firms. Our team is small, our impact is large, and our growth trajectory is steep.

 

The Role: AI Forward Strategic Operations Partner

This isn't a traditional executive assistant role. We're looking for someone who can become a strategic partner in building a family office empire. You'll work directly with the founder to operationalize AI-first processes, manage complex projects across three business units, and eventually take equity in what we're building.

This role is perfect for you if:

  • You're obsessed with AI and automation (you’re well-versed in the latest LLMs and cutting-edge AI tools)

  • You want to build something rather than just maintain it

  • You thrive as a generalist across real estate, consulting, and private equity- confident that with the right AI tools and context, you can reach 80% mastery with just 20% of the starting knowledge

  • You see this as a multi-year partnership with profit sharing and to help define our company, not just a job

  • You have an action-oriented, forward-looking mindset with strong accountability

 

Core Responsibilities

Business Operations & Executive Administration Support (50%)

  • Manage incoming messages for the founder and team inboxes and ensure correct routing and documentation alongside AI-powered systems.

  • Handle business operations tasks (bookkeeping, expense tracking, CRM management) and build standard operating procedures.

  • Manage the founder's calendar, priorities, team meetings, and project timelines.

  • Map core business processes across real estate and consulting verticals, leveraging AI tools to capture screen recordings or video walkthroughs, and create documented SOPs and documentation in the team's Notion account.

Business Development Support (20%)

  • Support AI consulting sales: proposals, onboarding, CRM management, and marketing across several digital properties.

  • Handle consulting partner, investor, and vendor communication for the Managing Partner and team.

  • Help prepare proposals and presentations for clients and partners about WNCP AI and other business units.

Real Estate Operations (20%)

  • Coordinate property management for 7 Maryland rental units, including tenant communications and maintenance.

  • Manage financial tracking for real estate portfolio ($2M+ in assets) and coordinate with local contractors.

AI Tools & Automation (10%)

  • Find, discover, and integrate new and best-in-class AI tools for SMBs, along with better ways of working to teach and show the team.

  • Help set up and standardize, and maintain AI systems like knowledge bases or shared prompt libraries.

  • Training included. Experts are loved, but anyone eager and a quick learner is welcome.

 

Required Qualifications

What Matters Most

  • AI Fluency: You use AI tools daily and can learn new ones quickly

  • US Work Experience: You must have worked for a US-based company in the past and be comfortable calling and talking with US partners; startup experience preferred.

  • Project Management: Experience managing small projects with small teams focused on quick execution

  • Remote Work Excellence: Proven track record of remote work with US clients, working US hours, and culture

  • Generalist Mindset: You are comfortable with new challenges, new domains, and can learn quickly and adapt

  • English Fluency: Excellent and amazing native-level written and verbal communication

  • Operational Mindset: Action-oriented, forward-looking looking and accountable

  • Digital Platforms: Familiarity with tools like Slack, Notion, CRMs, Google Drive, Dialpad, or similar automation platforms

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's or 6 years of work experience required; MBA or Business, or Technical degrees preferred

  • Background in chief of staff, project management, business analysis, and executive administration

  • US Real Estate, Startups, and Digital Marketing experience highly preferred

  • Technical background or bootcamp, or other training to understand technical aspects of AI, Machine Learnin,g and LLMs preferred

  • Strong personal interest in AI and AI-related news

 

Compensation & Growth

Immediate Compensation

  • Base: $1,000-2,000 USD/month (based on experience)

  • Profit Sharing: Company-wide profit-sharing program available after the first year

  • Equipment: Home Office Equipment Stipend Provided

  • Learning Budget: Learning budget for courses and AI tools

Benefits at WN Capital Partners

  • Family-oriented vibe and culture with an international remote and hybrid team

  • US dollar compensation (hedge against local currency fluctuations)

  • Flexible remote work with US business hours

  • Professional development budget

 

Success Metrics 

New hires begin with a 90-day starter probationary contract, providing an opportunity to adapt and integrate into our team and role effectively. Within this period:

  • Flexibility in Hours and Responsibilities: You may start on a part-time basis during the first 90 days, depending on your experience and our team's needs.

  • Adaptability and Learning: As you familiarize yourself with our processes, there may be adjustments to better align your role with your strengths and team requirements.

  • Communication and Feedback: Open communication is encouraged to ensure you receive the support needed to succeed.

By the end of the probationary period, you'll have a clearer understanding of the role and expectations and be fully integrated into our team culture.

Company Culture

We're not a corporation. We're a family office that operates like a startup, emphasizing family values, personal fulfillment, and sharing wealth-building principles to empower our team and others. This means:

  • Direct Access: You'll work directly with the founder, no bureaucracy

  • Rapid Learning: We try new tools and processes weekly

  • Global Team: US, Philippines, Latin America, and international contractors

  • Long-term Thinking: We're building generational wealth, not quarterly earnings

  • Work-Life Integration: Flexible hours, but high expectations during work time

  • Family Values: We prioritize your job enjoyment, personal development opportunities, and spreading ideas that build wealth to help others

 

Application & Interview Process

  1. Initial Application: Submit a resume and complete a multiple-choice quiz on required domains and skills.

  2. Optional Submissions: Include a video or written cover letter; portfolios, projects, or materials related to AI-based experience.

  3. Video-Based Interview: Invitation to our video interviewing platform to discuss your experience mapping business processes and record a short response

  4. Paid Assignment: Complete assignments with $100 offered for on-time submissions.

  5. Final Interview: Review assignments with the CEO and potentially other team members.

  6. Offer: 90-day probationary period with full benefits.

 

Important Notes

  • AI knowledge is mandatory. If you're not already using AI tools daily, this isn't the right fit.

  • We're looking for a partner, not an employee. The right person will grow with us over the years.

  • US business hours are non-negotiable. Our clients and properties operate on Eastern Time.
